name: Duruelo (Spain)
description: A red hoist third bearing the crowned municipal arms of Duruelo, separated by a blue and white wavy pale from the fly, which is divided horizontally crimson over green.
history: Duruelo adopted its arms and flag officially on 5 May 2014, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 25 August 2014; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two stripes in the proportions 1/3 and 2/3 separated by two blue wavy stripes.

features.role: wavy vertical stripe of blue and white between the hoist and the fly
white wavy stripe beside the blue
Duruelo arms — wavy pall on green with a sheaf, a tree and a saint
